//zoomEnabled: Founder ruling 2026-09-23 (docs/DECISIONS.md): no zoom in the app at all. Capacitor's default is already false, but the default is a fact about a dependency and this is a decision; stated here so an upgrade that flips the default cannot re-enable pinch on Android (setSupportZoom/setBuiltInZoomControls follow this flag). The page's own layers are the viewport meta in index.html, touch-action on html/body in styles.css and the gesturestart guard in app.js; test/no-horizontal-scroll.test.js pins all four.

ios.//allowsLinkPreview: Audit round 2 (touch-3): no link preview on a long-press. Capacitor's default is true, and a held card in this app is one <a href="#/..."> stretched over the whole card, so the default opened WKWebView's peek of capacitor://localhost/#/... with Open / Copy Link — a web affordance with nothing behind it in an app. Stated, like zoomEnabled, so an upgrade cannot flip it back. The page's own layer is the a[href^="#/"] rule in styles.css (the callout menu); test/tap-targets.test.js pins both.
